name: Codlino – COD Order Forms for WooCommerce
author: tahabelmezrar

sections.description:
Create multiple forms, customize fields, colors, font and order-button dimensions,
choose a WooCommerce product, and embed the form with [codlino_form id=”123″].
Supports simple and variable products, offer cards, quantity controls, optional
price display, and Arabic, French and English administration.
Orders are stored in WooCommerce with cash-on-delivery payment and on-hold
status. Stock reservation and order creation use WooCommerce APIs. Customers
are redirected to the standard WooCommerce order-received page.

There is no license key, paid unlocking, trial period, or form quota in this edition.

Important change in 0.8.0: this release removes previously available optional
features: phone/IP duplicate blocking and Moroccan-phone validation settings,
external webhooks/Google Sheets, blacklist management, preset designs, button
animation, custom thank-you page and JSON form import/export. These features
stop running even when enabled before upgrading. Existing WooCommerce orders
and forms are not deleted. User-selected colors remain; layout uses classic.
Review this scope change on staging before updating a store using these features.
Queued webhook deliveries from earlier versions are no longer processed.

Nonce verification, admin capability checks, input validation, honeypot, stock
checks and idempotent order submission remain. Removing the optional protection
panel does not remove these fundamental checks.

Privacy

This edition sends orders to WooCommerce in the same site. It does not provide
external webhook or Google Sheets transmission, licensing requests, or telemetry.
Orders contain the customer fields and connection IP normally used by the order.
Selected Google Fonts may load from fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com.
The site/default font and site-provided Janna do not require Google Fonts.
Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
PixelYourSite integration uses the installed plugin’s settings and consent. Codlino
does not install a pixel, collect a pixel ID, or send events independently.

Third-party assets

Bundled Tajawal font assets retain their accompanying SIL Open Font License.
Janna is not bundled and requires a licensed font supplied by the site owner.
sections.installation:
Requires WordPress 6.5+, PHP 7.4+ and WooCommerce 8.2+.
Install and activate WooCommerce and enable cash on delivery. Publish a simple
or variable product, create a form in Codlino, choose the product and copy its
shortcode to a page, post or Elementor Shortcode widget.
Shipping is included in the configured product price; this form does not offer
shipping-method selection. Configure the WooCommerce checkout page so the
standard order-received confirmation is available.
sections.changelog:
0.8.1

  • Isolate form admin routes and styles from Codlino Licensing.

0.8.0

  • Simplified free edition; removed optional features listed above.
  • Keep normal WooCommerce orders, receipt page and stock handling.
  • Preserve core submission security and existing form IDs/shortcodes.
  • Retain compatibility mapping for offers imported before this release.
